text.p: These are the leading stories in the Malawi press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The British High Commissioner to Malawi John Martin said on Thursday the country risked losing further budget support if over expenditure was not checked.

- Opposition party Alliance for Democracy (AFORD) plans to stage a peaceful demonstration against the country's only government controlled radio, Malawi Broadcasting Corporation, to protest against biased reporting.

- Three South Africans were arrested early this week in Machinga district, more than 100 km north east of Blantyre, one for possession of a fire-arm with 44 live ammunitions and two for illegal stay in the country.
